name: Otto Travel
description: Otto brings business travel bookings into Claude. Search flights and hotels, compare options, then book your choice. Your preferences filter search results (cabin class, seat, hotel brand, airline), and your loyalty numbers attach to reservations. When plans change, exchange or cancel a flight or hotel. It retrieves trip details on request: flight times, hotel addresses, confirmation numbers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Otto Travel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Otto Travel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.ottotheagent.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Otto Travel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otto Travel lists 14 MCP tools, including read_skill, search_flights, query_flights, book_flight, search_hotels, get_hotel_rooms, book_hotel, get_bookings, cancel_booking, task_status, read_preferences, and write_preference.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Otto Travel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Otto Travel in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Otto Travel MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otto Travel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Otto Travel is developed by Otto Trip, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
